title: What people in my community say
intro: Real WhatsApp messages and voice notes from people in my community.

receipts.alt: A WhatsApp chat. The student writes: It automated the 70 receipts I got from my client. This is something that usually takes me 3 days if I'm lazy. For it to even read my dashboard and the charts too. I'm super impressed. Chinenye replies: Yesss, it's the intelligence for me oo. It knew you already had formulars and it updated accordingly.
